features.name: Awakened Mind
features.desc: You communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet in a language you know.

features.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
features.desc: You form a psychic bond with a creature (Wisdom saving throw): it has Disadvantage on attacks against you, and you have Advantage against it. A number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.desc: Resistance to Psychic damage; a creature that attacks you with psionics takes the same amount back.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.desc: With a touch, you charm an Incapacitated creature into an indefinite servant (Wisdom saving throw).
